projects.creator: Hardik Graphix
projects.description: The film opens with the soulful resonance of the shehnai, gradually building anticipation before introducing the energetic beats of the dholak. This sound-led opening establishes the emotional atmosphere before transitioning into the traditional Gujarati ...
projects.fullDescription:
The film opens with the soulful resonance of the shehnai, gradually building anticipation before introducing the energetic beats of the dholak. This sound-led opening establishes the emotional atmosphere before transitioning into the traditional Gujarati Garba.

The creative approach focuses on connecting music, culture, and visuals to create an engaging festive experience.

Creative Direction

The opening sequence was designed around musical rhythm and emotional progression:

Shehnai: Establishing a devotional and atmospheric introduction.

Dholak: Building energy and anticipation through rhythmic transitions.

Garba Sequence: Celebrating Gujarati tradition through music and visual storytelling.

projects.fullDescription:
A high-energy visual campaign concept for the Predator Helios Neo 16, exploring the intersection of gaming technology, graphic design and cinematic storytelling.

The project combines bold condensed typography, Predator-inspired neon-green accents, dramatic lighting, futuristic environments and dynamic product compositions to communicate power, performance and immersion.

Creative Direction

The visual language is built around high contrast, oversized typography, layered compositions and vivid gaming imagery. Each frame highlights a different product feature while maintaining a consistent campaign aesthetic.

Creative Process

Graphic design and typographic composition

AI-assisted visual creation

Real-footage integration

Motion design and video editing

Cinematic colour grading and visual finishing

Objective

To transform technical product features into a visually engaging campaign that feels bold, immersive and performance-driven.

projects.fullDescription:
A 9-day Navratri visual series created by combining AI-assisted image generation, design research and Adobe Photoshop into one cohesive visual language.

The goal was to create posters that feel premium, devotional and contemporary rather than relying on conventional festival artwork.

Creative Direction

The visual system was built around:

30–40% Goddess portrait + white negative space + pigment textures + editorial typography + symbolic iconography.

Keeping the composition consistent helped the 9 posters feel like one campaign, while the colour, symbolism and mood changed with each day.

Research & Concept

Before creating the visuals, I researched each Navratri day to understand:

• The Goddess associated with the day
• Traditional symbolism and attributes
• Day-wise colour
• Relevant visual icons
• A meaningful devotional message

This research became the foundation for the AI prompts and overall art direction.

A Behind-The-Scenes breakdown of my AI + Motion Graphics workflow, showing how I transformed an AI-generated visual into a smooth cinematic video.

The focus of this project was not just generating an AI visual, but building a complete motion sequence with consistent visuals, controlled movement, timing and cinematic transitions.

AI Visual → Photoshop → Compositing → After Effects → Motion Design → Final Output

In Adobe After Effects, I developed the final sequence using layered animation, camera movement, transitions, timing adjustments and visual effects to create a smoother and more cinematic result.

The objective was to turn multiple digital management functions into a simple, engaging visual experience using 3D motion design.

The Concept

The visual story explores:

Billing
Inventory Management
Floor Management
Table Management

The visual direction was built around a modern and minimal 3D aesthetic, keeping the product as the central focus.
